Reviewer ACCEPT_WITH_CHANGES (items 5-9 applied). v1 (q0160) FAILed with an empty frame because the sidecar open_interest is blank in all 280,175 rows. v2 changes only the OI source: base frame = binary, open, accepting orders (capture-time), not weather, not crypto Up/Down; market OI from /oi?market=<cid1>,<cid2>,... (60 ids per request) fetched at frame-build time t_f (reply time, per batch, max asserted < the first /holders request); OI >= 1,000 and the OI terciles use the /oi value at t_f. Mixed clocks disclosed: accepting/closed/event OI at capture time, /oi at t_f (hours later); c uses OI at t_f, not at h. Missing states oi_lookup_failed / oi_absent / oi_nonnumeric are dropped and counted, never imputed; per-batch assertion that returned ids were sent (identity, no duplicates, count); more than 2 % of base-frame markets missing -> criterion h FAIL (written; the smoke is write-once). A network failure after retries writes nothing and exits 75. Criterion (e) records the /oi value, event OI for single-market events and the sum-top-20 ratios; threshold units are 'units unverified' unless /oi and single-market event OI agree (band 0.25) and sum top-20 <= 1.05 OI in at least half the picks. The output also discloses the realised frame and stratum sizes against the 1,500 + 300 sample. Cost: about 4,550 /oi requests (about 19 min at 4 rps) + ~20 /holders + 2 paging requests; timeout 5400 (the limiter enforces a minimum gap between request starts but does not offset reply time, and yields to the live collector; ~4,550 /oi requests at ~0.6 s per reply take ~45 min before any yielding). mem 700 (273k-market base frame about 0.3 GB measured on a synthetic frame; the sidecar is also held while reading). Seed arepo-cb8-hsmoke-v2. A timeout or exit 75 writes nothing, is NOT a v2 FAIL (the smoke cannot resume) and may be re-queued under a new id; the no-smoke-v3 rule is unchanged (only a written FAIL of a, b or h counts). Rules: v3 file b6ac7f7f... (v2 file 30e7f7f0... was superseded before any job ran: day_rolled guard in the snapshot); the output name/version cb8-holders-smoke-v2 is kept and binds to the v3 rules hash. Exit 2 if holders_smoke_v2.json exists, on a rules-hash mismatch or on a key/fingerprint problem; v1 smoke results are never accepted.
